title: 11 Best New Dollar Tree Christmas Gnome and Figurine Finds For $5 or Less - NewsBreak
text:
By Jessica Kelly ,
21 hours ago Shutterstock
You don't need to spend a ton to fill your home with cute Christmas figurines. Dollar Tree has holiday themed tiny gnomes, figurines, and plush seasonal characters that can bring a bit of personality to your seasonal display. With every item ringing in at $5 or less, you can grab a few favorites for the kids rooms without putting too much of a dent in your budget. Here are 11 Dollar Tree Christmas gnomes and figurines to look for before they're gone. 1 Christmas House Elf Plush Doll Dollar Tree
Give your holiday decor a little festive personality with one of these adorable plush elves . The variety of colors make them mix and match well, whether you place one on a bookshelf or mantel, they pull together the Christmas display. 2 Christmas Plush Toy Assorted Characters Dollar Tree
These adorable Christmas characters are an inexpensive way to add a little something extra to your holiday display. Put one into a Christmas basket, place a couple around the room, or stuff them into stockings for the kiddos. 3 Christmas House Moose Plush Toy Dollar Tree
A moose might not be the most Christmasy animal, but these plush characters blend into a cozy winter display perfectly. Their variety of colors make them especially cute when grouped together, but an individual moose also makes a statement. 4 Christmas House Gnome Tabletop Décor Dollar Tree
If your holiday decor always includes some gnomes, Dollar Tree has you covered. These tabletop characters come in a variety of colors and are tiny enough to put into spots that need a little extra Christmas touch. 5 Christmas House Plush Christmas Animals Dollar Tree
These festive plush animals come in assorted characters that make them a fun option for decorating your child's room or adding a lighthearted touch to the living room display. 6 Christmas House Plush Toys Dollar Tree
At times, the best holiday finds are the ones you can fill empty spaces with, without completely revamping the entire room. These assorted Christmas plush toys are an easy way to do that, placing them along existing decor. 7 Christmas House Decorative Shelf Sitter Dollar Tree
Give your mantel or bookshelf a festive look with these cute shelf sitters . They're built to look perfectly placed when sitting on the edge of a surface, making them an easy addition to areas that might otherwise go unnoticed. 8 Christmas House Tabletop Gnome Décor Dollar Tree
Dollar Tree is offering quite a few characters and gnomes this Christmas, and this tabletop collection gives you even more to choose from. They're an easy way to add a seasonal touch without needing large decor this season. 9 Christmas-Themed Mini Tabletop Décor Dollar Tree
Tiny decor and intentional pieces can make a big difference when you're adding the finishing touches to your holiday display. These miniature Christmas characters work well on a bookshelf, windowsill, desk, or other small spaces. 10 Christmas House Plush Toy Assorted Characters Dollar Tree
For another affordable option this Christmas, check out these assorted plush characters . They can work as decor leading up to Christmas, then double as small present topped or stocking stuffers when Christmas finally arrives. 11 Christmas House Standing Figurine Dollar Tree
Finish your holiday display with a Christmas character that can stand on its own. These assorted figurines make it easy to add some personality to a mantel or holiday village for $5 or less.For more daily news and tips to live your best life, join us over at BestLifeOnline.com .
